scenes.brief: Under the broad tree outside the exam building, Yun stands from their table with a carefully courteous smile, as Wan looks up with reddened, tear-bright eyes. Summer dapples, curious students blurred behind them, restrained social tension.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นลุกจากโต๊ะใต้ต้นไม้เมื่อคุยกับซ่งหว่านจบ

scenes.brief: At the exam gate, Grandfather De dabs sweat from Yun's face with a handkerchief while her mother watches, visibly relieved. Yun's bag still on her shoulder, summer glare broken by the shade of their parked car.
scenes.alt: ปู่ซ่งซับเหงื่อให้หลานสาวหน้าอาคารสอบ

scenes.brief: Wen approaches at the exam gate and the laughing family goes quiet. Yun gives him a small, formal bow; Jiu and De remain by her, their changed expressions making the new distance plain.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นก้มทักพ่ออย่างห่างเหิน

scenes.brief: Wide curbside view. Grandfather De turns Yun toward the car with his hand at her back while Jiu leaves with them, and casts a hard final look at Wen. Wan stays beside her father; school gate and passersby in the background.
scenes.alt: ปู่ซ่งพาซ่งอวิ๋นกับแม่กลับรถหลังโต้เถียงกัน

scenes.brief: At home in soft natural light, Jiu holds Yun close in an apologetic embrace. Yun wraps her arms around her mother's waist, surprised at first and then reassuring. Quiet domestic two-shot after the public confrontation.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วกอดลูกสาวแน่นเมื่อกลับถึงบ้าน

scenes.brief: Day two of gaokao, bright classroom with spaced desks. A stern exam proctor stands by Wan's desk after noticing her stare, while Yun ahead keeps her head over her own paper. Show no legible exam text.
scenes.alt: กรรมการคุมสอบหยุดที่โต๊ะซ่งหว่าน

scenes.brief: Beyond the exam exit, Jiu receives Yun's relieved running hug. De smiles beside them as they decide to celebrate with a favorite soup. Other weary but cheerful students stream out behind them.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นโผกอดแม่หลังสอบวันสุดท้าย

scenes.brief: Quiet nearby public park several days later. Yun cradles her favorite camera on a bench under trees as a familiar plump squirrel with full cheeks climbs onto her shoulder. Close natural scene, warm leaf light, she lets the animal approach freely.
scenes.alt: กระรอกแก้มตุ่ยปีนขึ้นไหล่ซ่งอวิ๋นในสวน

scenes.brief: At the same park bench Yun tightens a hand around the camera and answers her cousin's unfair mediation with composure. Shen looks taken aback; Wan stands just behind him, eyes downcast. Frame their separation with empty path between them.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นถามเจียงเซินให้ลองมองจากมุมของเธอ

scenes.brief: Yun returns to a waiting car at the park curb, her camera packed away and eyes bright with unshed tears. An older chauffeur beside the door looks concerned as she steadies herself and asks for an ice-cream stop.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นกลับมาที่รถและขอให้คนขับพาไปซื้อไอศกรีม

scenes.brief: In Yun's private photography gallery after the park incident, De stands among framed photographs. Yun holds up her camera to share what she photographed, visibly steadier after his offer of help. The displayed prints are nature photography.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นเปิดกล้องให้ปู่ดูรูปที่ถ่ายในสวน

scenes.brief: Early light in a modern corporate office. Xiang sits with her coffee, looking unusually burdened as she tells her younger brother Xuan what Shen said at the park. Two cups, tall windows and a quiet close conversation.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเซียงเล่าเรื่องเจียงเซินให้ซ่งเซวียนฟังที่บริษัท

scenes.brief: At the Jiang family dinner table, Xiang has just set her cutlery down sharply on porcelain. She looks squarely at her younger son Shen while older brother Su watches tensely. Show rigid posture and the untouched dinner, not physical aggression.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเซียงวางช้อนส้อมและเตือนลูกชายกลางโต๊ะอาหาร

scenes.brief: Near the late-June results release, Yun sits at the desktop computer with Jiu and De nearby. Xuan opens the door with Xiang behind him, their warm smiles lifting the tension. Family computing room, unmarked screen before results.
scenes.alt: อาทั้งสองมาทันเวลารอผลสอบกับซ่งอวิ๋น

scenes.brief: In Wen's separate spacious home, Wan waits at a computer before results, her face pale. Wen leans in with genuine concern while Shen stands close in solidarity. Distinct intimate framing contrasting the earlier large family gathering.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินถามอาการลูกสาวขณะซ่งหว่านรอผลสอบ

scenes.brief: Wan has just seen her gaokao total of 729 at the computer. Wen beams with pride, while Shen draws her hand away from the wrist she pinched in disbelief. Their delighted surfaces, modest home-office light.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินกับเจียงเซินยินดีที่ซ่งหว่านทำได้ 729 คะแนน

scenes.brief: Cut to Yun's computer room at the instant her own 730-point result appears. Jiu lifts a hand to her mouth, Xuan leans toward the screen and Yun stares, startled, with De and Xiang nearby. Composition centered on reactions.
scenes.alt: ครอบครัวตกตะลึงเมื่อผลสอบของซ่งอวิ๋นขึ้น 730 คะแนน

scenes.brief: After seeing her result, Yun rushes into her grandfather's arms and he cannot hide his pride. Xiang smiles beside them and Jiu discreetly wipes a tear. Warm candid family composition distinct from the screen reveal.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นโผกอดปู่ขณะที่แม่แอบเช็ดน้ำตา

scenes.brief: Yun speaks her total into the smartphone on speaker, calm and almost detached. De, Xuan, Xiang and Jiu listen in uncomfortable silence as the celebration has paused. Tight focus on Yun and the phone, with the others beyond.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นบอกคะแนนแก่พ่อผ่านโทรศัพท์ที่เปิดลำโพง

scenes.brief: Across town Wen stands dazed after dropping his smartphone; Shen bends to retrieve it from the floor. Focus on Wan beside them, jaw set and fist clenched, concealing her anger at losing by one point.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านกำมือแน่นเมื่อรู้ว่าแพ้หนึ่งคะแนน

scenes.brief: Alone on her bed, Wan scrolls Yun's anonymous Weibo photography account on her phone, a suppressed scowl visible in its light. Suggest image thumbnails without readable app text, close composition keeping the bedroom ordinary.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านนั่งเปิดบัญชีเว่ยป๋อของซ่งอวิ๋น

scenes.brief: Wen stands at his own front door watching Shen leave for the main family celebration. Shen inclines his head before turning away. A still, sparse composition emphasizing Wen remaining at the separate house.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินมองเจียงเซินเดินออกจากบ้าน

scenes.brief: Warm family dinner celebrating Yun's gaokao. At the younger cousins' table cheerful Zhi leans forward to ask Yun to tutor him; Su smiles and dishes are passed. Shen sits nearby, socially adrift amid the warmth.
scenes.alt: ซ่งจื้อขอให้พี่สาวช่วยติวในงานเลี้ยงฉลอง

scenes.brief: A closer angle at the cousins' dinner table when Shen learns Yun's photographs have sold for years. Shen looks stunned and quiet, Su faces him in surprise, while Yun looks down modestly toward the soda on the table.
scenes.alt: เจียงเซินอึ้งเมื่อรู้ว่าภาพถ่ายของซ่งอวิ๋นขายได้มานาน

scenes.brief: Morning sun filters into a Buddhist temple courtyard. Elderly nun Yin pauses sweeping, gripping the broom handle while listening to Wen and Wan's account. Wan bows politely, but the nun's clear, still gaze makes both visitors uneasy.
scenes.alt: แม่ชีจ้าวถือไม้กวาดและฟังสองพ่อลูกในลานอาราม

scenes.brief: In the monastery grounds, nun Yin calmly faces Wen and explains the old Song Group succession decision. Wen's startled eyes reveal the grievance she has recognized; Wan stands slightly aside, visibly uneasy in the still courtyard.
scenes.alt: แม่ชีจ้าวพูดถึงการเลือกประธานซ่งกรุ๊ปในอดีต

scenes.brief: Wen kneels on the monastery paving to plead for Wan as his mother turns her head back along the path to the prayer hall. Wan stands beside him. Show distance between Wen and the elder nun, her composed expression and his red eyes.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินคุกเข่าอ้อนวอนแม่ชีจ้าว

scenes.brief: At the Song family's reception hall, Yun firmly tells De she chooses Tsinghua and will decline special treatment. He listens without interruption. Contemporary, intimate two-shot with decisive direct eye contact from Yun.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นยืนยันกับปู่ว่าจะเข้าชิงหวาโดยไม่ขอสิทธิพิเศษ

characters: เฉียวอันฉี
scenes.brief: Childhood friend Anqi, with big round brown eyes and thick slightly wavy hair, excitedly clasps Yun's arm to congratulate her, in the family's reception hall. Yun smiles warmly but with a fleeting look of reserve.
scenes.alt: เฉียวอันฉีกอดแขนซ่งอวิ๋นเพื่อแสดงความยินดี

characters: เฉียวอันฉี
scenes.brief: After Anqi asks after the family troubles, Yun lets her gaze rise from her friend's hand to Anqi's searching eyes. A close, measured exchange with apparent tenderness and quiet uncertainty, in the same room after the adults leave.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นจับสังเกตสายตาเพื่อนสนิทขณะพูดเรื่องครอบครัว

characters: เฉียวอันฉี
scenes.brief: Anqi stares, momentarily stunned after Yun calmly explains why she handled the birthday revelation without an outburst. Show the childhood friends in the family reception hall, with contrasting guarded composure and genuine surprise.
scenes.alt: เฉียวอันฉีตกใจที่ซ่งอวิ๋นพูดถึงเรื่องวันเกิดอย่างใจเย็น

scenes.brief: Before university starts, a quiet transitional portrait of Wan considering her next step with a controlled, determined expression. Keep the background understated and contemporary and avoid adding a meeting or action absent from the story.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านทบทวนแผนของตัวเองก่อนเปิดเทอม

scenes.brief: Zhi playfully hugs Yun's arm in the outdoor commercial's dressing room, possessive as an affectionate younger cousin. Makeup mirrors, summer daylight through the window, stylist amused in the background. Wholly sibling-like warmth.
scenes.alt: ซ่งจื้อกอดแขนพี่สาวในห้องแต่งตัวกองโฆษณา

scenes.brief: Wan stops outside the dressing room holding water for the actor, hearing the siblings laugh through the doorway. Focus tight on her darkened phoenix eyes and steadying grip on the bottles, sunlight and production corridor beyond.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านชะงักนอกห้องแต่งตัวขณะถือน้ำมาส่ง

scenes.brief: Wan pauses with one hand on the inside door handle and tells Yun that their father is hospitalized. Zhi looks up near his mirror; Yun listens almost motionless. Keep the water on the room table from Wan's earlier entrance.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านหยุดที่ประตูเพื่อบอกข่าวว่าพ่อเข้าโรงพยาบาล

scenes.brief: Alone together in the dressing room after Wan leaves, Zhi peers anxiously at Yun's reddening eyes. She has said she might send flowers instead of visiting her father. Use the illuminated mirror and quiet midday light to frame the caring exchange.
scenes.alt: ซ่งจื้อเป็นห่วงเมื่อเห็นพี่สาวตาแดง

scenes.brief: Wide view on a hot outdoor commercial set. Yun holds out a water bottle and towel to sweaty Zhi during a break; beyond them Wan is a junior crew worker. Production camera, reflectors, practical ordinary clothes.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นส่งน้ำและผ้าให้ซ่งจื้อระหว่างพักถ่าย

characters: ผู้กำกับหู
scenes.brief: At the end of the shoot, middle-aged director Hu approaches the two cousins in sunset light and invites Yun to take part in his singing program. She listens thoughtfully, not yet committed. Crew pack equipment behind them.
scenes.alt: ผู้กำกับหูชวนซ่งอวิ๋นไปร่วมรายการร้องเพลง

scenes.brief: In the passenger cabin of the moving van at dusk, Zhi hugs Yun with relief after receiving her unconditional reassurance. She steadies him protectively. Frame them as teenage relatives supporting one another, with city lights outside and no romantic framing.
scenes.alt: ซ่งจื้อกอดพี่สาวด้วยความโล่งใจในรถตู้

scenes.brief: At the Song family dinner, Jiu sets honey-roasted chicken on Yun's plate as Zhi enthusiastically mentions the director's singing invitation. De watches warmly beside a table filled with favorite dishes.
scenes.alt: ซ่งจื้อเล่าเรื่องรายการร้องเพลงให้ครอบครัวฟังระหว่างมื้อเย็น

scenes.brief: At the end of the family dinner, De offers Yun musicians and a rehearsal space. Yun smiles at the extravagant offer and chooses the shopping-mall rehearsal room. Jiu and Zhi sit with them in a warm, distinctly contemporary dining room.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นเลือกไปซ้อมร้องเพลงที่ห้างบี

scenes.brief: After Wen is discharged for gastritis, Wan asks him gently to take better care of himself. He smiles with paternal confidence and she gives him a measured smile. Quiet face-centered composition with the tension in her eyes, no new medical event.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านเตือนซ่งเหวินให้ดูแลตัวเองหลังออกจากโรงพยาบาล

scenes.brief: In the mall rehearsal room Yun has just put down a microphone and approaches Jiu, newly confident about singing again. Musicians pack equipment behind them; acoustic wall panels and instrument stands identify the music space.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นคุยกับแม่หลังกลับมาซ้อมร้องเพลง

scenes.brief: Restrained flashback to Jiu's wedding: a younger Jiu as bride is greeted by Huaping, a gentle-looking guest with the same striking phoenix-shaped eyes as Wan, who arrives with her new companion. Use softer light to mark the memory.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วนึกถึงตอนที่ฮวาผิงมาร่วมงานแต่งของเธอ

scenes.brief: Non-graphic aftermath at the public restroom washbasins, after both girls have fallen. Concerned women bend to help fully clothed Yun and Wan back up. Focus on startled expressions and helping hands; no impact, injury detail, or sensational framing.
scenes.alt: ผู้หญิงในห้องน้ำเข้าช่วยพยุงซ่งอวิ๋นกับซ่งหว่าน

scenes.brief: At a bright modern hospital intake corridor two women have brought Yun and Wan from the mall. Yun thanks the helpers and asks for contact details as staff guide the girls toward the examination rooms. Natural eye-level action.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นขอช่องทางติดต่อหญิงสองคนที่ช่วยพามาโรงพยาบาล

scenes.brief: At the hospital, the two girls are wheeled out after examination when Wen confronts seated Yun sharply. Jiu is stunned by the accusation, De stands sternly beside her, Shen remains near Wan. Clean clinical light; no violence shown.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินกล่าวหาซ่งอวิ๋นทันทีที่ออกจากห้องตรวจ

scenes.brief: In the hospital corridor Jiu bends toward her daughter and asks where she hurts. Yun quietly reassures her with wet eyes; De watches attentively behind them. Frame faces and comforting body language, no close-up of an injury.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วเข้ามาดูอาการและถามว่าลูกเจ็บตรงไหน

scenes.brief: As they are leaving the hospital, Jiu halts and firmly tells Wen to honor their divorce agreement. Yun watches with surprise at her mother's strength and De waits beside her, walking cane in hand. Clear blocking and distance between former spouses.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วหยุดบอกซ่งเหวินให้ทำตามข้อตกลงการหย่า

scenes.brief: That night Yun confesses the full story in De's study. He leans back in his desk chair with a thoughtful, sharp gaze, warning her to protect herself. Warm lamplight over warm wood, with Yun visibly comforted by being understood.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นเล่าเรื่องทั้งหมดให้ปู่ฟังในห้องทำงาน

characters.name: ซ่งอวิ๋น
characters.description: Eighteen-year-old Chinese high-school graduate, slender and bright with clear peach-blossom-shaped eyes. An accomplished photographer and former childhood singer, she is developing deliberate composure in public while remaining affectionate with trusted relatives.

characters.name: ซ่งหว่าน
characters.description: Yun's alleged older half-sister, only months older and also taking gaokao. Slender with glossy black hair and striking phoenix-shaped eyes, a graceful, gentle public manner, and tightly concealed anger. Daughter of Huaping.

characters.name: โจวจิ่ว
characters.description: Yun's middle-aged mother. Expressive eyes, gentle manner and visible protectiveness. Contemporary polished adult wardrobe suited to a wealthy family. Her occasional tears and firmness toward her former husband are both important.

characters.name: ซ่งเต๋อ
characters.description: Elderly paternal grandfather, sharp attention behind clouded eyes, uses a cane. He is openly tender with Yun, strong-willed toward his adult children, and still works in his study.

characters.name: ซ่งเหวิน
characters.description: Middle-aged father of Yun and claimed father of Wan. Broad back and sharp eyes formerly associated with warmth; now visibly partial toward Wan. The eldest son of De and Yin.

characters.name: เจียงเซิน
characters.description: Yun's second-eldest male cousin, a young Tsinghua management student and musician. He is protective of Wan and can look both concerned and rigidly convinced of his own fairness.

characters.name: เจียงซู
characters.description: Eldest male cousin, young Tsinghua management student, older brother of Shen and son of Xiang. He is observant, openly fond of Yun, and more composed than Shen in family disputes.

characters.name: ซ่งเซียง
characters.description: Yun's elegant middle-aged paternal aunt, a polished executive and mother of Su and Shen. She is composed enough to rebuke her son calmly, with a direct and commanding gaze.

characters.name: ซ่งเซวียน
characters.description: Yun's younger paternal uncle, the youngest of his siblings, father of Zhi and a senior Song Group executive. His corporate manner shifts naturally to a warm smile with his niece.

characters.name: ซ่งจื้อ
characters.description: Sixteen-year-old actor and Yun's youngest male cousin, two years younger than her. Bright, affectionate, and expressive, with sharp sword-like eyebrows. His young appearance and close sibling-like bond with Yun are central.

characters.name: จ้าวอิ๋น
characters.description: Elderly Buddhist nun, paternal grandmother of Yun and mother of Wen. Her gaze is still, clear and penetrating. She appears in simple nun's robes, working quietly in the monastery courtyard and heading to its prayer hall.

characters.name: เฉียวอันฉี
characters.description: Yun's childhood friend and fellow recent school graduate. Big round dark-brown eyes, thick slightly wavy hair and pale pink lips. Outwardly sunny and affectionate, with flashes of doubt in her eyes.

characters.name: ผู้กำกับหู
characters.description: Middle-aged male advertising and music-program director, practical and encouraging on the outdoor commercial set. He remembers Yun's childhood singing competition.

characters.name: ฮวาผิง
characters.description: Wan's late mother, seen in a wedding-day memory as a gentle and sweet-mannered adult woman with striking phoenix-shaped eyes related to Wan's appearance. She is a wedding guest in that scene.
